CustomField.description: Where a field action notification Case stands, in the words the Notifications step uses. Blank on any other Case. The Field Action Cases report filters on it (contains), so every value carries the word Acknowledgment or Acknowledged.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Field_Action__c), "", IF(IsClosed, IF(ISPICKVAL(Response_Outcome__c, "No Response"), "Closed Without Response, No Acknowledgment", "Acknowledged"), IF(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Response_Due__c)), Response_Due__c < TODAY()), "Pending Acknowledgment, Overdue", "Pending Acknowledgment")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Acknowledged, Pending Acknowledgment (with Overdue once the response due date has passed), or Closed Without Response.
CustomField.label: Acknowledgment
